description: This file defines the class PreferredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterStrategy, a strategy for filtering silo placement based on metadata in Orleans. It manages ordered metadata keys and minimum candidate requirements for placement decisions.

classes.name: PreferredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterStrategy
classes.description: A placement filter strategy that considers ordered metadata keys and minimum candidate count for silo placement filtering.

methods.name: AdditionalInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the strategy by extracting 'ordered-metadata-keys' and 'min-candidates' from grain properties, with validation.

methods.name: GetAdditionalGrainProperties
methods.description: Generates additional grain properties, including ordered metadata keys and minimum candidates, for placement logic.
